title: Doctor for Dispensary
summary: Canara Bank invites applications for engaging a Doctor on a contract basis for its dispensary at H.O. Annex, National Games Village, Koramangala, Bengaluru. Eligible candidates with MBBS or MD/PG degree and required post-qualification experience must submit their applications by December 7, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Applicant should possess an MBBS degree with a minimum of 10 years of experience, or an MD/PG degree with a minimum of 7 years of post-qualification experience.
Must submit self-attested copies of educational certificates and two references from respectable persons along with the application.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Dispensary at H.O. Annex, National Games Village, Koramangala, Bengaluru

how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official website.
Fill in all personal details, qualification, experience, expected remuneration, and preferred time slot.
Attach self-attested copies of MBBS/MD/PG certificates and two references.

Send the filled application via Email to hosa@canarabank.com or via Speed Post to Canara Bank, HOSA Section, H R Wing, Head Office, #112, J C Road, Bengaluru – 560002, superscribing the document as 'Application for engaging Doctor'.
